3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I sat at the long table in my council chambers, facing Elena and Laurento.

4.speaker: Elena Werner
4.text: "I hope you are well today, Your Majesty."

5.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
5.text: "Indeed... We seem to be having a cold spell of late. But I am certain spring is just around the corner."

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: They both spoke in somewhat unnatural tones. I saw flashes of fear in their eyes.

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "Come on, you two... it's just me."

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: "I know the events of my mother's birthday seemed rather extreme. But trust me, it had to be done."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Correct, Mr. Esquibel. The daffodils in the Palace gardens have already begun to bloom."

13.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
13.text: "I do not doubt it, Your Majesty."

14.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
14.text: "Oh, I wasn't aware I was acting out of the ordinary. Please accept my apologies."

18.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
18.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_HugoGone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_GrandVizier_Empty"] == true)) == false

20.speaker: Elena Werner
20.text: "Such actions are sometimes necessary for the health of the realm."

22.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
22.text: "With the... departure of our Grand Vizier and Duchess Azaro, there are now two spots on the council that need filling."
22.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_HugoGone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_GrandVizier_Empty"] == true)) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Lucita"] == true)

26.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
26.text: "With the... departure of our Grand Vizier and General Azaro, there are now two spots on the council that need filling."
26.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_HugoGone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_GrandVizier_Empty"] == true)) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Lucita"] == true) == false)

27.speaker: Elena Werner
27.text: "Fortunately, we're quite close to the Hearing of Petitions. I'm sure you'll be able to find suitable candidates to fill both seats."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Remember that your own seat on this council is by no means guaranteed. Ms. Werner."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "Despite their treachery, they were competent advisors. They leave big shoes to fill."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "It makes no difference in the end. *I* am the one making the decisions. You people are nothing but leeches."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "There are still a few months to go. I trust you to help me run the country in the meantime."

35.speaker: Elena Werner
35.text: "I have never once taken it for granted."

36.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
36.text: "Both Azaro generals are committed to seeing it through, despite the fate of their House and Duchess."

44.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
44.text: "It appears the transfer of all three provinces to Crown control is well underway."

51.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
51.text: "It appears the transfer of Valenqiris and Cardesse-Montaklar to Crown control is well underway."

52.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
52.text: "It appears the transfer of Cardesse-Montaklar to Crown control is well underway."

53.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
53.text: "The Crown Princess continues to reside in Palas Toras in Monqiz. All other members of the noble houses in question have been vacated from their estates."

60.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
60.text: "It appears the transfer of Cardesse-Montaklar and Brenas to Crown control is well underway."

61.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
61.text: "All members of the noble houses in question have been vacated from their estates."

62.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
62.text: "All Azaros have been vacated from their estates."

63.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
63.text: "All members of the noble houses in question, including your cousin Hubertus, have been vacated from their estates."

64.speaker: Elena Werner
64.text: "They shall live as commoners, with no special privileges or entitlements."

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: She allowed herself a small, grim smile.

66.speaker: Elena Werner
66.text: "Naturally, the seizure of their estates will bring a substantial boost to our treasury. Some of their assets, however, were held offshore."

70.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
70.text: "With the... departure of your uncle from the council, the Grand Vizier seat will need filling."
70.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_HugoGone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_GrandVizier_Empty"] == true)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == false)

71.speaker: Elena Werner
71.text: "Fortunately, we're quite close to the Hearing of Petitions. I'm sure you'll be able to find a suitable candidate."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "My uncle was a competent advisor. He leaves big shoes to fill."

73.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
73.text: "With the... departure of our security councilor, there is a seat at this table that needs filling."
73.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_HugoGone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_GrandVizier_Empty"] == true)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == false) == false)

74.speaker: Elena Werner
74.text: "Fortunately, we're quite close to the Hearing of Petitions. I'm sure you'll be able to find a suitable candidate."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "Lucita was a competent advisor. She leaves big shoes to fill."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Taddeus was a competent advisor. He leaves big shoes to fill."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "That was not the reason behind my actions. But I admit it's a nice bonus."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Perfect. I have big plans for that funding."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "That money should go straight into the hands of the people."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Is that so? I should have done this a long time ago."

87.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
87.text: "With regards to the ongoing war in Pales..."

88.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
88.text: "General Carlos Robles Azaro is committed to seeing it through, despite the fate of his relatives."

92.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
92.text: "With luck, they should finally be able to bring the Princess home."

93.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
93.text: "With regard to the ongoing Pales reunification talks..."
93.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_PreparationsUnification"] == true)

97.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
97.text: "Duke Reinhart has shown a willingness to continue the process. But he does warn that your 'lack of respect for Rizia's provincial autonomy' has given him pause."

99.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
99.text: "Her Excellency Queen Beatrice, meanwhile, has sent us a telegram praising your show of dominance over Rizia's wayward nobility."
99.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_PreparationsUnification"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == true)

103.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
103.text: "President Wiktor Smolak, meanwhile, has sent us a telegram praising your show of dominance."
103.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_PreparationsUnification"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Wehlen_Allied"] == true)

110.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
110.text: "Prime Minister Saltana of Morella has notified us that while she is not against the expropriation of noble estates in principle, she does question the method by which we have done so."
110.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_PreparationsUnification"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Wehlen_Allied"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Allied"] == true)

112.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
112.text: "Fortunately, international blowback over the... incident... has been minimal. Especially since few specifics have been leaked to the world at large."
112.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_PreparationsUnification"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Wehlen_Allied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Allied"] == true) == false)

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "To be in charge of a nation sometimes requires one to make bold decisions. Our trade partners know that."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "The world must know that the King of Rizia is not to be messed with."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "I don't want anyone to get the wrong idea. This was a defensive measure, not some sort of power grab."

125.speaker: Elena Werner
125.text: "This doesn't fall under either of our purview, but with the security councilor indisposed..."

126.speaker: Elena Werner
126.text: "It's our proud duty to tell you that the unrest that has plagued Rizia for so long has come to an end."

127.speaker: Elena Werner
127.text: "You'll hear more about this from your security councilor, but for now..."

128.speaker: Elena Werner
128.text: "That will be it for now. I'm sure you have a lot of work to do."

132.speaker: Elena Werner
132.text: "The concessions we were forced to make to the protesters did negatively impact our economy."

136.speaker: Elena Werner
136.text: "Miraculously, the concessions we were forced to make to the protesters barely dented our economy."
136.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Collapse"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Reduction"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_Appease"] == true)

137.speaker: Elena Werner
137.text: "The upheaval we experienced did negatively impact our economy."

138.speaker: Elena Werner
138.text: "Miraculously, the upheaval we experienced barely dented our economy."

142.speaker: Elena Werner
142.text: "Our energy reserves are still recovering from the sabotage incident. It may take some time before we're at our former capacity."

146.speaker: Elena Werner
146.text: "Thanks to your quick actions after the sabotage incident, our energy reserves are on track to reach their former capacity."

150.speaker: Elena Werner
150.text: "And we remain in debt to Rizian Royal Gold. I hope it isn't too late for that to be squared."

154.speaker: Elena Werner
154.text: "Our robust energy reserves will undoubtedly help us weather the months ahead."

158.speaker: Elena Werner
158.text: "Thankfully, we have adequate energy reserves to weather the months ahead."

159.speaker: Elena Werner
159.text: "I am concerned that our energy reserves are insufficient to weather the months ahead."
159.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Revolutionary_Pipeline_Sabotage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Energy"] > 10) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Energy"] > 5) == false)

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "Concerning news. But at least we're now in the position to begin working on our recovery."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "With the anti-monarchists out of the way, our economy will soar even higher than before."
164.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_LoanAmount"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Collapse"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Reduction"] == true) == false)

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "We handled the unrest. We can handle Rusty."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "There is still much work to be done. We've got to address the root cause of the uprising, not just recover from it."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "We should take some time to rest on our laurels. We defeated a revolution, after all."

169.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
169.text: "I have no doubt it will, Your Majesty."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "What do you want, a medal? That's literally the least that I expect."

185.speaker: Elena Werner
185.text: "The ringleader -- Adarfo, was it? -- now sits in the Porte Drazon Citadel, awaiting your judgement."
185.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_Oppress"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == false)

189.speaker: Elena Werner
189.text: "The ringleaders have all been arrested, and the movement has scattered to the winds."
189.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_Oppress"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == false) == false)

190.speaker: Elena Werner
190.text: "Your decision not to resort to harsh measures has apparently paid off."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "Thank you, Ms. Werner. And I'm sorry again about all the recent unpleasantness."

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "Yes, lots of work to be done. No thanks to my shrunken council."

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: She and Laurento stood up and bowed.

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "Let recent events be a lesson to you. Nobody goes against Romus Toras and lives."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "You both served my father for years. Would he have been proud of what I did?"

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "I lost my wife. My heir. I have no one."

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "I lost my uncle. My closest advisor. I have no one."
206.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true)

209.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
209.text: "I am sorry, Your Majesty. This cannot be easy for you."

211.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
211.text: "He would have understood, Your Majesty. Reigning is not easy."

213.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
213.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. We would never dream of doing so."

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: I kept my eyes on my oldest and most loyal councilors as they departed my chambers.

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Still, something is better than nothing. We’ll take what we can get."
